attributes.input.value: In the NIST GAI Profile's MEASURE 2.3 table, what GAI Risks are tagged to action MS-2.3-001 ('Consider baseline model performance on suites of benchmarks when selecting a model for fine tuning or enhancement with retrieval-augmented generation')?
attributes.output.value:
The GAI Risk associated with the suggested action MS-2.3-001 is Information Security.

This can be seen from the information provided in the NIST GAI Profile, where MS - 2.3 -001, Suggested Action = Consider baseline model performance on suites of benchmarks when selecting a model for fine tuning or enhancement with retrieval-augmented generation.. and MS - 2.3 -001, GAI Risks = Information Security.
